default: Keep until explicitly reviewed; no automatic deletion or relocation

directories.docker-recovery: Manual archive: retain the verified cold backup and recovery installer until an independent copy has been restored and checked
directories.tools: Keep pinned active versions and one verified rollback version; review obsolete installers after 30 days
directories.soak-artifacts: Keep active runs and unresolved failures; review completed synthetic artifacts after 30 days, retaining at least 7 complete runs and their reports
directories.cloud-delivery: Review superseded bundles after 7 days; retain the current validated bundle and at least 2 rollback bundles
